targets.query:
from(bucket: "sensor_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_reading")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "front_cm")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 2s, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "sensor_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_reading")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "rear_cm")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 2s, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "sensor_data")
  |> range(start: -30s)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_reading")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "min_clearance")
  |> mean()

from(bucket: "sensor_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_reading")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "servo_angle")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 2s, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "sensor_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_reading")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "speed_ms")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 2s, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
